description: Run the pinned deterministic tabu search on a complete symmetric weighted graph.

workspace.reason: Maximum result is a length word, up to seven tour city indices, and a cost word.

input.encoding: [city_count, iteration_count, tabu_size, upper-triangle edge weights in source text line order]
input.edge_order: (0,1),(0,2),...,(1,2),... with each undirected edge listed once
input.graph_rule: Every pair of distinct cities has exactly one positive-weight undirected edge.

output.encoding: [tour_length, closed-tour city indices..., best_cost]; city a is 0

contract.start: Use city 0 (label a), matching the first character of the first edge line in the pinned source file representation.
contract.initial_tour: Repeatedly choose the first least-weight adjacent unvisited city, using adjacency insertion order from the stated edge order. Compute the closed cycle cost over all tour edges.
contract.neighborhood: For each current interior city in route order, swap it with each other interior city in route order. Discard duplicate tours on first occurrence, then stable-sort by total closed-tour cost ascending.
contract.tabu_move: For each candidate in sorted order, find the first differing route position and represent the exchange as [candidate_city, current_city]. Reject it when either orientation is in the tabu list.
contract.tabu_memory: Append the selected exchange. After selection, if list length is at least tabu_size, remove the oldest exchange. This source ordering retains at most tabu_size-1 exchanges.
contract.best_and_stop: Perform exactly iteration_count steps. Update the best only for strictly lower cost. Return the best closed tour with the appended neighborhood cost removed, leaving the repeated start city in place.
contract.determinism: No randomness is used. Ties follow adjacency insertion order and stable neighborhood sorting.
contract.bounds: 4..6 cities, 0..8 iterations, tabu_size 1..3, complete symmetric graph, integer edge weights 1..99.
